<module id="parallel2serial">
    <description>Parallel to serial conversion, where every four input bits are converted to a serial one bit output (MSB to LSB).</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operations.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="d" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit parallel data input.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Valid signal indicating the availability of serial output.</output>
        <output id="dout">Serial output representing the converted data.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Assigns the most significant bit of the parallel input to the serial output (dout). On each clock cycle, if the counter (cnt) is 3, indicating the last bit of the parallel input, the module updates the data register (data) with the parallel input (d), resets the counter (cnt) to 0, and sets the valid signal (valid) to 1. Otherwise, the module increments the counter (cnt) by 1, sets the valid signal (valid) to 0, and shifts the data register (data) one bit to the left, with the most significant bit shifted to the least significant bit. Counter Register: If the reset signal (rst_n) is high, the register (cnt) is incremented by 1.</implementation>
    <task>
        <id>reset_counter</id>
        <description>Resets the counter to 0.</description>
        <call>cnt <= 0;</call>
    </task>
    <task>
        <id>increment_counter</id>
        <description>Increments the counter by 1.</description>
        <call>cnt <= cnt + 1;</call>
    </task>
    <task>
        <id>update_data_register</id>
        <description>Updates the data register with the parallel input.</description>
        <call>data <= d;</call>
    </task>
    <task>
        <id>set_valid_signal_to_one</id>
        <description>Sets the valid signal to 1.</description>
        <call>valid <= 1'b1;</call>
    </task>
    <task>
        <id>shift_data_left</id>
        <description>Shifts the data register one bit to the left.</description>
        <call>data <= {data[2:0], data[3]};</call>
    </task>
    <task>
        <id>set_valid_signal_to_zero</id>
        <description>Sets the valid signal to 0.</description>
        <call>valid <= 1'b0;</call>
    </task>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[1:0]">Counter register to keep track of the current position in the data register.</reg>
        <reg id="data" width_description="[3:0]">Data register to store the parallel input data.</reg>
        <reg id="valid">Valid signal to indicate the availability of serial output.</reg>
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)>
            <if condition="!rst_n">
                <call>reset_counter();</call>
            </if>
            <else>
                <if condition="cnt == 3">
                    <call>update_data_register();</call>
                    <call>reset_counter();</call>
                    <call>set_valid_signal_to_one();</call>
                </if>
                <else>
                    <call>increment_counter();</call>
                    <call>set_valid_signal_to_zero();</call>
                    <call>shift_data_left();</call>
                </else>
            </else>
        </always>
    </logic_description>
    <assign id="dout" value="data[3]" />
    <assign id="valid_out" value="valid" />
</module>
